pages.reader_job: Choose a guide for a video editing symptom

serp.query: DaVinci Resolve social safe zone guide overlay PNG tutorial

pages.competitor_strengths: Concrete import/removal instructions, reusable assets and explicit plugin limitations.
pages.gap: A no-plugin workflow that distinguishes editing and monitor canvases, checks animation and verifies guide removal.
pages.original_contribution: A no-plugin workflow that distinguishes editing and monitor canvases, checks animation and verifies guide removal.

brief.direct_answer: To check a social-video layout in DaVinci Resolve, place a matching transparent guide on a separate track above your edit, inspect the full sequence, then disable that track before rendering. A guide helps you compose; it does not move captions or promise that every app interface will leave them visible.
brief.title: DaVinci Resolve Safe-Zone Overlay Workflow
brief.description: Add a temporary guide track in Resolve, check moving captions and disable the overlay before rendering your final vertical video.
brief.exclusions: Resolve implementation only; existing Canva and Premiere URLs retain their editor jobs.

pages.reader_job: Transparent PNG Looks Black? Check Alpha and Layers

serp.query: transparent PNG black background overlay video editor alpha

pages.competitor_strengths: Explains alpha and placing assets above footage.
pages.gap: Two-background diagnosis separates an opaque file from an empty black composition; explains guide versus comparison exports.
pages.original_contribution: Two-background diagnosis separates an opaque file from an empty black composition; explains guide versus comparison exports.

brief.direct_answer: A black background behind a PNG does not by itself prove that transparency is missing. The viewer may be showing transparent pixels against black, or the image may contain an actual opaque rectangle. Place it over a bright test background in your editor to tell the difference before changing blend modes.
brief.title: Transparent PNG Looks Black? Check Alpha and Layers
brief.h1: TRANSPARENT PNG Looks Black? Check the Overlay
brief.description: Diagnose an opaque PNG overlay by testing alpha, layer order and export choice before changing blend modes in your video editor.
brief.exclusions: Repair transparency in an existing asset; Canva owner retains asset creation.

pages.reader_job: Blurry Captions After Export? Find the Softening Step

serp.query: how fix blurry subtitle text export video resolution captions

pages.competitor_strengths: Separates upscaling, graphics resolution and upload compression.
pages.gap: Locate the first softening stage and compare a controlled short export, avoiding universal quality presets or sharpening claims.
pages.original_contribution: Locate the first softening stage and compare a controlled short export, avoiding universal quality presets or sharpening claims.

brief.direct_answer: Find the first stage where the captions become soft: the editor preview, the saved video or the uploaded playback. Comparing those stages is more useful than repeatedly increasing every quality setting. Keep the original project and make a short test export containing the affected text.
brief.title: Blurry Captions After Export? Find the Softening Step
brief.h1: BLURRY CAPTIONS After Export? Check These Steps
brief.description: Compare the editor preview, saved export and uploaded playback to find why captions look blurry and choose a focused correction.
brief.exclusions: Rendered detail loss; existing readability guide retains font/contrast and moving-background legibility.

pages.reader_job: Video Plays Sideways? Fix Rotation Before Placement

serp.query: video sideways rotation metadata browser fix

pages.competitor_strengths: Explains metadata versus rendered transforms and offers tools.
pages.gap: Diagnose orientation versus mirroring/cropping and order rotation before captions, without universal playback promises.
pages.original_contribution: Diagnose orientation versus mirroring/cropping and order rotation before captions, without universal playback promises.

brief.direct_answer: If a clip is upright on your phone but sideways in an editor or preview, investigate orientation before changing the canvas or cropping. The file may contain display-rotation information that different software handles differently. A quarter-turn correction and a portrait crop solve different problems.
brief.title: Video Plays Sideways? Fix Rotation Before Placement
brief.h1: VIDEO PLAYS SIDEWAYS? Fix Rotation First
brief.description: Separate display rotation from cropping, correct the clip in your editor and test an upright export before positioning captions.
brief.exclusions: Orientation correction; existing fit/fill guide retains framing and bars.

pages.reader_job: Translated Subtitles Too Long? Fix the Layout

serp.query: multilingual subtitles line breaks text expansion video translation

pages.competitor_strengths: Explains segmentation, target-language expansion and timing review.
pages.gap: Language-specific layout handoff with script rendering and marked-block review; no transplanted broadcast character limit.
pages.original_contribution: Language-specific layout handoff with script rendering and marked-block review; no transplanted broadcast character limit.

brief.direct_answer: A translation can need different line breaks, more screen space or more reading time than the original caption. Review each language as its own timed layout. Reusing the source caption's rectangle and making the translated font smaller can leave the words technically visible but difficult to follow.
brief.title: Translated Subtitles Too Long? Fix the Layout
brief.h1: TRANSLATED SUBTITLES Too Long? Fix the Layout
brief.description: Review translated subtitles for meaning, line breaks, timing and script rendering, then test each language version for placement.
brief.exclusions: Translation layout; existing timing and readability owners remain linked prerequisites.
